Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, VINEET SARAN
Arbitration: Arbitration agreement – Arbitration clause in notice inviting tender in commercial contracts – Pre-deposit clause-10% “deposit- at-call” of the amount claimed by party invoking arbitration, if arbitrary of Art. 14 of the Constitution – Held: A pre-deposit of 10% would discourage a party to an arbitration from invoking this alternative dispute resolution process, contrary to the object of de-clogging the court system, and would render the arbitral process ineffective and expensive
Decision Date : 11-03-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2713/2019 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
